verdict.rationale: The product offers two install modes—a locked, read-only bundle that only updates via an explicit `npx skills update` pull, or an editable copy where skills become 'ordinary files you own' in your repo—which gives some control over when changes land and implies normal git-based versioning/rollback, but there is no explicit changelog, diff view, or rollback command for the skills themselves. Missing for 10: dedicated version history or diff/review UI for skill changes, an explicit rollback mechanism, and any evidence of reviewing skill updates before applying them (beyond opting into `update`).
